name: Move a bulky object with a partner
short_description: Move a bulky object with a partner once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.

description: Move a bulky object with a partner means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
